content:
Formula: Time-Dependent Schrödinger Equation
Exact Expression: i\hbar \frac{\partial \psi}{\partial t} = \hat{H}\psi
Definitions: Fundamental differential equation governing the wave function and unitary deterministic time-evolution of a non-relativistic quantum mechanical system.
Derivation/Reference: Erwin Schrödinger, Annalen der Physik (Quantisierung als Eigenwertproblem, 1926)
Example: Particle in a 1D infinite square well of width L: stationary energy eigenvalues E_n = (n^2 pi^2 hbar^2) / (2 m L^2)
Domain: quantum_mechanics
Assumptions: Non-relativistic quantum regimes (v << c); Isolated quantum system undergoing unitary evolution
Common Errors: Interpreting wavefunction psi as physical matter density rather than probability amplitude whose norm |psi|^2 gives probability density
subject: Time-Dependent Schrödinger Equation
